assumptions: Creative choice: a silent, widescreen sculpture film titled The Shape of a Fold.

Artwork, geometry, lighting, shadows and grain are generated procedurally; no external assets, product facts or third-party asset licenses are involved.
Requires WebGL and the harness-provided gsap.min.js. One paused GSAP timeline controls all state deterministically.
